title: Black Hole Waste Management v2
author: gshmails
installation_method: Build a local sc4pac channel using a preserved local ZIP; stage with the installed sc4pac CLI; merge only generated new package/asset records and files into the active profile; rebuild O-menu catalogue after game exit.
next_steps: Inspect and hash downloaded ZIP; confirm included game files and readme.
Preserve original ZIP and create/build local channel metadata.
Run sc4pac in isolated staging profile.
After game exit: back up active profile and catalogue; copy new files and merge only new manager-generated records.
Rebuild catalogue and verify new lot and unchanged existing plugin payload.
